blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is chapter ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Tkinter library se interactive (user ke kaam ka jawab dene wale) GUI programs design kar sakenge (bana sakenge).
Python applications ko databases se jor (connect) sakenge aur un par CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete: data dalna, parhna, badalna, mitana) kar sakenge.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein students Python ke built-in GUI toolkit Tkinter se aasan istemal wale (user-friendly) Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) banana seekhenge. Woh windows, frames, labels, buttons aur entry fields banayenge, aur pack(), grid() aur place() se layout (widgets ki tarteeb) sambhalenge. Woh event handling ki mashq karenge, yani user ke kaam (jaise click) ko functions se jorna, aur aik saada login form banayenge. Chapter mein database ke concepts, SQL, Python ko database se jorna (connectivity) aur SQLite ya MySQL ke saath bunyadi CRUD operations bhi hain.

blocks.prompt: Is chapter ke do bare hisse kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation: Pehla: Tkinter se GUI banana (windows, frames, widgets, layout aur event handling, aakhir mein login form). Doosra: Python se databases (SQL, connection aur CRUD operations).

items: Hissa 1: Tkinter se GUI: window, frames, widgets, pack()/grid()/place(), events.
Hissa 2: databases: SQL, Python se connection, CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete).
